purpose: Admit a state that contrasts with the following action or fact.
keywords: Verb stem / adjective / noun + ながらも
Although I felt anxious, I applied.
Although it is small, it is a comfortable room.
Although still a child, she understood her responsibility.
formation: Verb stem / adjective / noun + ながらも
restrictions: This concessive use differs from doing two actions simultaneously.
mistake: With nouns, familiar phrases such as 子どもながらも are most natural.
